claims: Bolivia will face Iraq in a 2026 FIFA World Cup inter-confederation playoff final.
The Bolivia vs. Iraq playoff final is on Tuesday, March 31, 2026.
The Bolivia vs. Iraq playoff final is at Estadio BBVA, Monterrey, Mexico.
Bolivia secured their spot by beating Suriname 2-1 on March 26, 2026.
The winner of the Bolivia vs. Iraq playoff final qualifies for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup group for the playoff winner is Group I with France, Norway, and Senegal.
Goals in Bolivia's 2-1 victory over Suriname were scored by substitutes Moises Paniagua and Ramiro Vaca (penalty).
Bolivia and Iraq previously played to a 0-0 draw in a 2018 friendly match.
Bolivia finished seventh in CONMEBOL qualifying.
